mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM tb_user_profile_signal WHERE user_id=#{userId}

SELECT current_state.* FROM tb_user_profile_signal current_state WHERE current_state.user_id=#{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user_profile_signal newer WHERE newer.user_id=current_state.user_id AND newer.memory_id=current_state.memory_id AND newer.persona_version=current_state.persona_version AND (newer.revision > current_state.revision OR (newer.revision=current_state.revision AND newer.id > current_state.id)) ) ORDER BY current_state.revision ASC,current_state.id ASC
